issues.desc: background.md Key Insights says "B4/B5/B10 exclude A1" but A1 is never defined or named anywhere in background.md. A standalone reader cannot determine that A1 is the prompt-only arm without already knowing §1 of the spec. The 5 arms are mentioned by count but none are named.
background.md Key Insights mentions "§5 the GLMM + common-cell denominators" but GLMM is not expanded anywhere in background.md; a reader without statistics background has no context.

background.md Trigger Event says the program "reached infra-(a) piece 4" but infra-(a) is not explained. A standalone reader cannot determine what the (a) category means or how many infra pieces exist in total.
